title: Midterm elections movement brainstorming
discussion_signal: The thread moves from political threat perception to discussion of protests, local events, volunteer driving, and voting. Replies disagree about strategy and institutional resistance, making visible the translation from private judgment to collective action and its uncertainty.
linked_research_question: When does material or institutional pressure become organizing, protest, voting, lobbying, or a public demand?
limits: Intentions and event links are not completed action or policy effect
Political claims are contested and not independently adjudicated
